networkPolicy.desc: Facebook is blocked; maps, routes and route books stay open

notes:
Traced on a device while browsing routes and points with photos. What it needs: api.off-road.io and parse.off-road.io (its backend), tracks.off-road.io, files.off-road.io (route books as PDF), map tiles, ims.gov.il (weather) and storage.googleapis.com (the fixed previews of the map types). Blocked: the Facebook SDK.

userContentHosts: s3.off-road.io and f002.backblazeb2.com, its file storage on Backblaze, which is where user photos appear to come from, and upload.wikimedia.org. All of off-road.io sits behind Cloudflare, so the split was decided by blocking these and checking that photos go while routes stay; to be confirmed on a device.
